title: Structure, every time
text: Job is specific, structure and draft a confidential information memorandum for a sell-side deal, organizing company information into one investor-ready document with consistent formatting and a narrative that holds together the same way on every run. What isn't in the skill MD's steps isn't part of the job.

title: Carry-out
text: SimBuilder doesn't write your CIM, it runs the skill MD's fixed steps on it the same way every time. Your turn.

title: Your turn
text: Here's the prompt, read it with me. Paste this into Claude. I want to structure and draft a confidential information memorandum for a sell-side M in a process.
